subject: BrightCore HQ immersion — scheduling & arrival details
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Levin <sara.levin@brightcore.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: BrightCore HQ immersion — proposed dates & NDA

Hi Sara,

Great to meet over the call yesterday — thanks for the time. As discussed, we'd love to host a half-day immersion at Redwood HQ so your product and platform teams can see a live run of the integration and ask detailed infra questions. Suggested window: Wednesday, Jan 17, 10:00 AM — 2:00 PM PT (arrival 9:45 for badging).

Logistics we can cover: conference room + AV, host demo run-of-show, lunch, and a short security briefing. Two asks on our side to keep things moving:
- Can you share the attendee list (names + emails + company IDs) so we can pre-provision badges?
- We need a mutual NDA on file before any deep product access. I attached our standard mutual NDA for quick review and DocuSign if that helps (attachment: NDA_Redwood_BrightCore_v1.pdf).

Kimberly (cc'd) will lead the day from a technical perspective; Marcus (cc'd) handles on-site ops. If Jan 17 doesn't work, what other dates next week look good?

Thanks — excited to host you all.

Best,
Logan
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0123

Attachment: NDA_Redwood_BrightCore_v1.pdf (PDF, 87 KB)
From: Sara Levin <sara.levin@brightcore.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: BrightCore Legal <legal@brightcore.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jan 2028 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BrightCore HQ immersion — proposed dates & NDA

Hi Logan — thanks, this sounds perfect.

Quick update: the exec who wants to join has a board prep conflict on Jan 17 and asked if we can move the visit to Friday, Jan 19 (same time window: 10:00–2:00 PT). That would get our leadership and engineering team in the same room.

Also: can you send a DocuSign link for the NDA? Our legal team will push it through their review. I've attached our vendor intake form for your ops team (attachment: BrightCore_vendor_form.pdf) — it includes emergency contact and dietary restrictions.

Apologies for the short notice. If Jan 19 is doable we can lock flights today.

Best,
Sara Levin
Head of Partnerships, BrightCore
Sara.Levin@brightcore.com

On Fri, Jan 13, 2028 at 11:22 AM Sara Levin <sara.levin@brightcore.com> wrote:
> Hi Logan — thanks, this sounds perfect.
>
> Quick update: the exec who wants to join has a board prep conflict on Jan 17 and asked if we can move the visit to Friday, Jan 19 (same time window: 10:00–2:00 PT).

Hi Sara — Jan 19 works for us. I sent the NDA through DocuSign this afternoon (link below) so your legal team can sign — please route to BrightCore Legal for signature.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/XYZ-Redwood-BrightCore

Marcus — can you provision conference room B2 (capacity 12) and set us up for full AV (projector + HDMI adapters + 1 mic)? Also please add a 12:00 PM working lunch for 10 people with a vegetarian option on the menu per BrightCore_vendor_form.pdf.

Kimberly — we'll run a 90-minute technical demo starting at 10:15, then a 30-minute Q&A with engineering leadership. I'll send the run-of-show in a follow-up.

Sara — once the NDA is signed, could you send the finalized attendee list? We will pre-print badges and have a reception desk escort.

Thanks — locking Jan 19 on our side.

Best,
Logan

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Levin <sara.levin@brightcore.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jan 2028 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: BrightCore visit — final ops checklist and arrival instructions

Hi all — final ops note ahead of Friday's visit. Per the forms and the signed NDA received from BrightCore legal (NDA_Redwood_BrightCore_signed.pdf), here is the runbook: 

- Arrival / Badging: Visitor table at HQ lobby (9:30–10:00). Please bring government ID for each attendee. Visitor badge form must be completed in advance or on arrival (we have copies at the desk).
- Parking: Reserved parking for BrightCore guests in Lot C (spaces B12–B15). Park in any of those spots and bring the parking ticket to the desk for validation.
- Room & AV: Conference Room B2 reserved 9:30–3:00. Projector, HDMI + USB-C adapters, and a single lapel mic confirmed. Will bring an Apple TV device in case a cast is needed.
- Lunch: Catered boxed lunch at 12:00. Vegetarian and gluten-free options confirmed per your intake form.
- Wi-Fi / VPN: Guest Wi-Fi (Redwood-Guest); passcode will be provided at badging. If any engineer needs VPN access to internal test beds, please coordinate with Kimberly ahead of time.
- Emergency: Building evac map and first-aid kit at reception. Marcus cell: (415) 555-0199.

Attachments included: Visitor_Badge_Form.pdf; NDA_Redwood_BrightCore_signed.pdf.

If anything changes between now and Friday, reply-all and I'll update the calendar event. Looking forward to hosting the BrightCore team.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Events & Facilities
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Visitor_Badge_Form.pdf (PDF, 12 KB); NDA_Redwood_BrightCore_signed.pdf (PDF, 92 KB)
